[p0 | acting_agent | action_plan]
First-call diverse probe to learn action semantics: right(4) and down(2) to find what moves (likely the blue slider handle), then a click on the left blue handle center to test interactivity. Board has a slider(top), a 3x3 lit grid in a diamond pattern, and a purple box showing the SAME diamond pattern.

[p1 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Simon-says hypothesis: BIG grid demoed a directional sequence UP,LEFT,RIGHT,DOWN (cells top-mid,mid-left,mid-right,bot-mid flashed in order). Reset for a clean attempt, then input first two directions up(1),left(3) and watch for a progress indicator (left handle sliding along rail) before committing to the rest of the sequence.

[p2 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Handle is a slider on the rail; left(3) moved it 4 cols left toward the dock. Push left twice more and watch whether it keeps advancing, blocks at the narrow rail section (rows21-22 stop at col22), or docks/rewards at the left box.

[p3 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Handle advancing 4 cols left per press (now cols27-30). Push left twice toward dock; watch for a block at the narrow rail section (rows21-22 stop at col22) or a dock/reward at left box cols12-16.

[p4 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Handle is blocked at col23 facing left and cannot dock by moving left. ACTION1(up) and ACTION4(right) effects are still unknown (only ever consumed by the demo). Probe up then right from this controlled blocked state to learn whether they rotate the handle facing or move it, which is needed to find the real path to the dock.

[s0 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=1 engine=0 accuracy=100.0

[p5 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Handle cannot reach dock (confined cols23-39), so dock-goal is wrong. Test Simon-says hypothesis: grid demo showed direction sequence UP,LEFT,RIGHT,DOWN; reproduce it by setting handle facing in that order (1,3,4,2) and watch for reward or a grid/state change confirming progress.

[p6 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Facing-sequence did not win and grid/purple are static; clicking the grid has never been tried. Click a lit cell (top-mid, 30,50) and an unlit corner (25,50) to test whether grid cells are interactive (toggle/select), which would reveal the real win mechanic.

[s1 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=2 engine=1 accuracy=100.0

[p7 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Clicking grid cells turns them green; goal appears to be greening the 4 diamond cells matching the purple target (TM,ML,MR,BM). Re-click mistaken corner TL(25,50) to test if green toggles off, and click diamond cell ML(25,55) to green it.

[p8 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Toggle rule confirmed. Green the two remaining diamond cells MR(35,55) and BM(30,60) so all 4 diamond cells (TM,ML,MR,BM) are green matching the purple target; expect reward.

[s2 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=3 engine=2 accuracy=100.0

[p9 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Diamond completion shrank the handle to 2x2 (rows19-20) instead of winning. A 2-tall handle can pass the narrow rail that blocked the 4-tall one at col23. Drive it left toward the dock (cols12-16) and watch whether it passes col23 and docks/rewards.

[p10 | acting_agent | action_plan]
2x2 handle at cols21-22; drive left twice (2 cols/press) to reach rail left end col17 adjacent to the dock, expected win/reward.

[s3 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=4 engine=3 accuracy=100.0

[p11 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Dock-at-col17 did not win. Handle is now docked; re-complete the diamond (green TM,ML,MR,BM) to test whether completing the diamond while docked triggers the win; watch the 4th completing click for reward vs another shrink.

[p12 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Both docking and diamond-completion reward hypotheses falsified. Test the one untested physical action: press left while the 2x2 handle is flush at col17 to see if it enters the dock cavity (cols13-16) or is a hard no-op, distinguishing whether the dock is enterable.

[p13 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L2 = L1 rotated vertical. Grid lit cells {TL,TM,MM} match the reference target. Green those 3 cells; the 3rd completing click should trigger the check that shrinks the 4x4 handle to 2x2 so it can pass the narrow neck (as in L1). Observe the shrink before driving up to the top dock.

[s4 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=5 engine=4 accuracy=100.0

[p14 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L2 check moved the 4x4 handle up past the neck to rows19-22, aligned with the 4x4 dock interior (cols31-34 rows11-14). Drive up: first press to rows15-18, second press should push it off-rail into the dock = win (analogous to L1 final dock push).

[p15 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 target from reference legend = {TM,MM,BM} (middle column); grid lit cells match. Green those 3 cells to trigger the check that frees/moves the handle, then observe the transformation before navigating the bent rail to the bottom-left dock.

[s5 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=6 engine=5 accuracy=100.0

[p16 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 handle in a 2D gray chamber must reach bottom-left dock via a down-left exit channel. Probe down(2) then left(3) to learn whether the chamber allows 2D free movement, the per-press step size, and the handle facing/axis behavior before committing to the bent path.

[p17 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 4x4 handle at (26,31). Verified clean 4-wide exit channel cols27-30 (red13+arm) to dock cols22-26. Route LEFT(align to cols27-30), DOWN x3 (down through red channel+arm to rows38-41), LEFT into dock fill = overlap dock = WIN.

[s6 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=7 engine=6 accuracy=100.0

[p18 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Red(13) gate is impassable; handle stuck above it. Detour to the candidate switch: up x2 to rows22-25, then right x2 toward the value-4 framed socket (cols47-50) which likely unlocks the red gate. Observe whether the gate/pink box change en route.

[p19 | acting_agent | action_plan]
4x4 handle is stuck (red gate impassable, cannot reach right structures) -- try ACTION6 probing of right-side structure. Click the magenta/dark-red box, the value-4 socket, and the red gate to test if any new element is interactive and opens the gate.

[s7 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=8 engine=7 accuracy=100.0

[p20 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Clicks on new elements were no-ops. Drive the 4x4 handle right (from cols35-38) toward the value-4 framed socket (cols47-50) to test whether value-4 is passable and whether reaching the socket triggers the red gate to open.

[p21 | acting_agent | action_plan]
4x4 handle cannot reach dock or right structures; only the projectile mechanic remains. Aim handle light-right via LEFT(3), then re-complete the grid {TM,MM,BM} to re-fire the check and emit a projectile RIGHTWARD toward the magenta box (val13, linked to the red gate). Observe tick frames for the projectile and any gate change.

[p22 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Projectile fires in the handle facing direction (step60: faced left -> shot left, missed). Press RIGHT to face the handle right (toward the magenta box at cols55-58), then re-complete the grid {TM,MM,BM} to emit a projectile RIGHTWARD into the box (val13, linked to the red gate). Observe whether the box/gate change.

[p23 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Rightward projectile destroyed the magenta box and removed the red gate (all val13 gone; channel now rail). BFS route from handle (22,43) to the bottom-left dock: L,D,D,L,L,L,D,L = [3,2,2,3,3,3,2,3]; final LEFT overlaps the dock = WIN.

[p24 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: move handle to firing position (27,27) facing left (D,D,L,L), then complete grid middle-column {TM,MM,BM} to fire a leftward projectile down the arm at the pink target(val13), which should destroy the linked red gate. Stop after to verify the gate is gone before driving to the dock.

[s8 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=9 engine=8 accuracy=100.0

[p25 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Solve the DIAMOND legend {TM,ML,MR,BM} (color15=L1 shrink legend) to test whether its check shrinks the 4x4 handle to 2x2; a 2x2 handle on the finer 2-lattice can reach row29 so a left projectile aligns with the arm rows29-30 to hit the pink target.

[p26 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Diamond legend confirmed-shrank handle to 2x2 (rows27-28 cols27-28, facing LEFT) but it is misaligned by 2 rows with the arm+pink-target channel at rows29-30. Press DOWN (2) to slide the 2x2 handle to rows29-30 cols27-28 (dest rail passable), then LEFT (3) to slide onto the arm at cols25-26 and re-face LEFT. This positions the handle to fire a leftward 2x2 projectile straight down the rows29-30 arm into the pink val13 target (linked to the red gate). Stopping to verify position+facing before solving the middle-col legend to fire.

[p27 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Handle is now 2x2 at rows29-30 cols25-26 facing LEFT, aligned with the arm/target channel (rows29-30) after DOWN+LEFT. Solve the middle-column legend {TM,MM,BM}(val6) by clicking the 3 middle-column big-grid cells TM(30,50),MM(30,55),BM(30,60) to turn them green; when GREEN==pattern the CHECK fires a leftward 2x2 projectile down rows29-30 into the pink val13 target, destroying all val13 cells including the red gate (cols47-49) that seals the right-side dock. Watch tick frames for the projectile + gate removal.

[s9 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=10 engine=9 accuracy=100.0

[p28 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Gate destroyed (all val13 gone). Drive 2x2 handle from rows29-30 cols25-26 into the right-side dock. RIGHT(4) into chamber cols27-28; 3xDOWN(2) to rows35-36 (aligned with dock entrance rows35-38); then RIGHT(4) traversing rows35-36 toward the dock (cols51-54 val10). This batch reaches ~cols39-40; will continue RIGHT next call until handle overlaps dock => WIN. All route cells verified rail(2).

[p29 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Handle 2x2 at rows35-36 cols39-40 facing right, on the dock-entrance row. rows35-36 cols41-50 are clear rail, cols51-54 are the dock (val10). Six RIGHT(4) presses move the handle col39->51; the final press destination cols51-52 overlaps the dock => WIN Level 4. Budget=12 ok.

[p30 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 has 3 DISCONNECTED rail systems (verified by flood-fill): the 4x4 handle sits isolated in the middle plus-chamber (rows15-18 cols35-38), while both projectile-target boxes (red top, orange bottom-left) are on the LEFT system and the dock+gates are on the RIGHT system. The handle cannot drive between them, so the TELEPORT legend must relocate it. Solve val11 legend {TL,TM,MM} via grid clicks TL(25,50),TM(30,50),MM(30,55) to trigger the teleport and OBSERVE the destination slot (critical unknown for routing the rest of the level).

[s10 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=11 engine=10 accuracy=100.0

[p31 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Teleport (val11) moved the 4x4 handle to the RIGHT rail (rows35-38 cols51-54, facing down), directly below the orange12+red13 gates and the dock (rows11-14). Press UP(1) to face the handle UP (advancing to rows31-34, rail verified clear), then solve the val6 projectile legend {TM,MM,BM}=TM(30,50),MM(30,55),BM(30,60) to fire a projectile UP the rail. Expect it to hit the orange12 gate (rows20-22) and destroy all val12 (same-color destruction as L4). Observe the projectile + gate removal before planning the red13 clear and dock entry.

[p32 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Firing the projectile up at the bare right-rail gate did NOT destroy it (projectile blocked like a wall, gates intact). Gates are only destroyed by hitting the val6-bordered TARGET boxes on the LEFT system (L4 linked-color rule). The handle is stuck on the RIGHT rail (disconnected from left). Re-solve the teleport legend val11 {TL,TM,MM}=(25,50),(30,50),(30,55) to learn whether the teleport destination cycles to a LEFT slot (so the handle can fire at the target boxes). Observe the new handle location.

[p33 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Discovered TWO size-matched teleport slots: a 4x4 slot on the RIGHT (where the 4x4 handle keeps landing) and a 2x2 slot at rows39-40 cols29-30 on the LEFT system (connected to both val6-bordered target boxes). To reach the left targets I must shrink the handle. Solve val15 DIAMOND {TM(30,50),ML(25,55),MR(35,55),BM(30,60)} to shrink the handle 4x4->2x2, then solve val11 {TL(25,50),TM(30,50),MM(30,55)} to teleport the now-2x2 handle to the 2x2 LEFT slot. Grid auto-clears between checks. Observe the handle landing on the left system before planning the target-box fires.

[s11 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=12 engine=11 accuracy=100.0

[p34 | acting_agent | action_plan]
2x2 handle is on the LEFT system (rows39-40 cols29-30, facing up); both gates still intact. To clear them I must fire at the val6-bordered target boxes. First target: red box atop the vertical rail (cols15-18). Navigate 6x LEFT(3) to cols17-18 rows39-40 (junction with the vertical rail), then 3x UP(1) to probe whether the handle can cross the yellow(val4) slot at rows31-34 (where only cols16-17 are rail). This tests val4 passability/parity. Observe where the handle stops before committing the projectile fire.

[p35 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Handle (2x2, rows35-36 cols17-18, facing UP) is blocked below the yellow(val4) slot; odd column-parity prevents reaching the clean cols16-17 channel. Fire the val6 projectile legend {TM(30,50),MM(30,55),BM(30,60)} to send a projectile UP toward the red target box (cols15-18). Tests whether the projectile passes the yellow markers at col18/rows31-34 (col17 is clean). If it hits the red box, all val13 (incl the red gate sealing the dock) should be destroyed. Observe projectile travel + gate status.

[s12 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=13 engine=12 accuracy=100.0

[p36 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Red gate cleared (projectile passed the yellow markers, destroyed all val13). Now clear the orange gate by firing at the orange target box (bottom-left, val6 border cols3-6, val12 core rows44-45). Descend the 2x2 handle 4x DOWN(2) from rows35-36 cols17-18 to rows43-44 (clean rail), then LEFT(3) to face left (cols15-16 rows43-44), then fire val6 {TM(30,50),MM(30,55),BM(30,60)}. Projectile travels left along rows43-44 (row44 clean lane passes the yellow corners) into the orange box -> destroy all val12 incl the orange gate sealing the dock. Observe gate status.

[p37 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Both gates destroyed (val13=0, val12=0); right rail open to the dock. The 2x2 handle is on the left system and the teleport is size-matched (2x2 -> left 2x2 slot). To reach the RIGHT 4x4 slot and the 4x4 dock I need a 4x4 handle. Test whether re-solving the DIAMOND legend val15 {TM(30,50),ML(25,55),MR(35,55),BM(30,60)} GROWS the handle back to 4x4 (size toggle). Observe the handle size change before teleporting.

[p38 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Diamond grew the handle back to 4x4 (size toggle confirmed). Both gates cleared, right rail open. Solve teleport legend val11 {TL(25,50),TM(30,50),MM(30,55)} to send the 4x4 handle to the RIGHT 4x4 slot (rows35-38 cols51-54), then press UP(1) 6x to drive it up the cleared right rail (cols51-54): rows35-38->31-34->27-30->23-26->19-22->15-18->11-14. The final UP lands on the DOCK (rows11-14 cols51-54, val9/10) => WIN Level 5. Budget 26 ok.

[p39 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 = same mechanic as L5, 3 disconnected rail systems. Handle 4x4 must shrink to move between systems. First solve DIAMOND val15 (30,50)(25,55)(35,55)(30,60) to shrink handle 4x4->2x2, then solve TELEPORT val11 (25,50)(30,50)(30,55). CRUX: there are three 2x2 val11 slots (SYS4 c54-55, dock-side SYS_B c30-31, red-box SYS_C c13-14) and the size-matched teleport destination cannot be determined statically. OBSERVE which slot the 2x2 handle lands in to resolve the teleport rule before routing to fire at the red/orange target boxes and into the dock.

[s13 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=14 engine=13 accuracy=100.0

[p40 | acting_agent | action_plan]
2x2 handle teleported to SYS_C slot (rows41-42 cols13-14, facing up). Navigate to fire at the RED target box (val6 border cols17-20, val13 core): RIGHT(4),RIGHT(4) to cols17-18 rows41-42, then UP(1) to rows39-40 cols17-18 facing up (clean rail lane cols17-18 up to box at row36), then fire val6 {TM(30,50),MM(30,55),BM(30,60)}. Projectile travels up and hits the red box -> destroys all val13 incl the bare red gate (cols42-44). Observe gate removal.

[p41 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Red gate cleared (val13=0); orange gate still seals dock. The orange target box is on system A (handle side), now reachable since the red gate that blocked it is gone. To fire it cleanly I need a 2x2 handle ON system A, but the 2x2 teleport goes to SYS_C. Since shrink/grow is in-place and only ONE 4x4 slot exists (SYS4=system A): GROW the 2x2 back to 4x4 (diamond {(30,50),(25,55),(35,55),(30,60)}), then TELEPORT (val11 {(25,50),(30,50),(30,55)}) which deterministically sends the 4x4 to the SYS4 4x4 slot (rows37-40 cols53-56) = system A. Next I will shrink in-place there and drive to fire LEFT at the orange box. Observe the 4x4 landing on system A.

[p42 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Green set is empty; handle is 2x2 at SYS_C slot facing up. Click the three building cells (0,0)+(0,1)+(1,1) to exactly match the 11-teleport legend and fire a TELEPORT check. Goal: observe where the 2x2 teleports (SYS_B r34-35c30-31 / SYS_A r38-39c54-55 / back to SYS_C) to resolve the ambiguous 2x2 routing - reaching SYS_A is required to fire the projectile LEFT at the orange box and open the sealed dock. Cheap (3 of 38 budget), directly probes the key blocker.

[s14 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=15 engine=14 accuracy=100.0

[p43 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Step177 teleport BOUNCED: 2x2 handle still at SYS_C slot (cols13-14 rows41-42) - no other 2x2 slot exists (SYS_A/SYS_B are 4x4-framed), so 2x2 teleport no-ops. BFS confirms the 2x2 is confined to the SYS_C left rail strip; it must GROW to 4x4 to reach a 4x4 slot. Direction map decoded: 1=LEFT 2=RIGHT 3=UP 4=DOWN. Drive handle from (13,41) up the strip to top-left (19,35) [path nodes (15,41)(17,41)(17,39)(17,37)(17,35)(19,35)], the grow-ready spot whose 4x4 footprint (cols17-20 rows33-36) covers the green grow-marker. Next call: fire diamond GROW check, then 4x4 teleport toward SYS_A to fire the projectile LEFT at the orange box.

[p44 | acting_agent | action_plan]
CORRECTED direction map: DIFF coords are (row,col) not (col,row), so 1=UP 2=DOWN 3=LEFT 4=RIGHT. My prior plan sent the 2x2 handle DOWN/LEFT into the slot frame -> it only re-aimed, still at rows41-42 cols13-14. Now drive RIGHT,RIGHT (onto rail cols15-18), then UP,UP,UP up the SYS_C vertical strip, then RIGHT to land 2x2 topleft (19,35) = grow-ready spot whose 4x4 footprint cols17-20 rows33-36 covers the green grow-marker. Turn+move in one press when dest is rail. Next: fire diamond GROW -> 4x4, then teleport toward a 4x4 slot (SYS_A) to fire projectile LEFT at the orange box.

[p45 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Handle is 2x2 at topleft cols19-20 rows35-36 on the grow-ready spot (footprint cols17-20 rows33-36 covers the green grow-marker + rail = passable). Build the diamond legend pattern {N(0,1)=(30,50), W(1,0)=(25,55), E(1,2)=(35,55), S(2,1)=(30,60)} to fire the 15-diamond SIZE-TOGGLE check. Expect GROW to 4x4 keeping bottom-right corner (20,36) -> handle occupies cols17-20 rows33-36. Click order avoids prematurely matching teleport/projectile legends. Next: fire 11-teleport as 4x4 to reach a 4x4 slot (SYS_A) and fire projectile LEFT at the orange box.

[p46 | acting_agent | action_plan]
GROW succeeded: handle now 4x4 at cols17-20 rows33-36 facing right. Growing re-framed SYS_A with a nested outer+inner B-frame (outer cols52-57 rows36-41 / inner cols53-56 rows37-40), marking it as the active same-size teleport target for the 4x4 handle. Build the 11-teleport legend {(0,0)=(25,50),(0,1)=(30,50),(1,1)=(30,55)} to fire TELEPORT. Expect the 4x4 to land at SYS_A inner frame cols53-56 rows37-40, row-aligned with the orange box (rows37-40). Next: face LEFT, fire 6-projectile to destroy box and open orange gate to the dock.

[p47 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Teleport landed the 4x4 handle at SYS_A (cols53-56 rows37-40), facing RIGHT, row-aligned with the orange box (cols37-40 rows37-40); gap cols41-52 is all rail. Press LEFT (aid3) to face the handle LEFT (it slides to cols49-52, still rows37-40, now aimed at the box). Then build the 6-projectile legend (center column {(0,1)=(30,50),(1,1)=(30,55),(2,1)=(30,60)}) to FIRE a projectile leftward -> destroys the orange box and clears the linked orange gate (cols33-36 rows14-16), opening the dock. Handle is 4x4 so no grow-token spawns. Next: drive the handle up into the dock.

[p48 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Projectile destroyed the orange box; orange gate cleared, dock open. But the 4x4 handle (cols49-52 rows37-40) is on the SYS_A rail system, DISCONNECTED from the dock. SYS_B (cols29-32 rows33-36) is now nested double-framed = the active 4x4 teleport destination, and it sits on the dock rail system. Fire the 11-teleport legend {(0,0)=(25,50),(0,1)=(30,50),(1,1)=(30,55)} to jump the 4x4 to SYS_B. Next I will SHRINK to 2x2 (a 4x4 cannot realign to the 4-wide central column from SYS_B) and drive up the column into the dock to win.

[s15 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=16 engine=15 accuracy=99.5

[p49 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Teleport landed the 4x4 handle at SYS_B (cols29-32 rows33-36) on the dock rail system, but a 4x4 cannot realign to the 4-wide central column (cols33-36) from here. Fire the diamond SIZE-TOGGLE legend {N=(30,50),W=(25,55),E=(35,55),S=(30,60)} to SHRINK 4x4->2x2 (keeps bottom-right corner (32,36) => 2x2 at cols31-32 rows35-36). Note: the size-toggle appeared to refill the step budget at step193, so this also helps the tight budget. Next: drive the 2x2 up the central column into the dock to win.

[p50 | acting_agent | action_plan]
This attempt is unwinnable: the 2x2 handle (cols29-30 rows33-34) needs 13 moves to drive up the central column into the dock, but only ~8 budget rows remain (green col62-63 rows56-63). Budget analysis shows only GROW refills budget (+8 once at step193); teleport/projectile/shrink consume, and grow/shrink oscillation nets ~0 - so I cannot extend enough. RESET to refill the full per-attempt budget, then execute the fully-known solution efficiently (this run wasted ~9 moves on a direction-mapping error and an exploratory teleport probe). Score and cleared levels are preserved by RESET.

[p51 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Fresh full budget after RESET. Handle starts 4x4 at cols41-44 rows21-24. Phase 1 of the verified 47-action win plan: fire DIAMOND to SHRINK 4x4->2x2 (clicks (30,50)(25,55)(35,55)(30,60)), then fire TELEPORT (clicks (25,50)(30,50)(30,55)) to send the 2x2 to the only 2x2 slot SYS_C (cols13-14 rows41-42). Teleport destination is size-determined so robust to shrink landing. Next phases: drive to red box and fire UP, grow, teleport to SYS_A, fire orange box, teleport to SYS_B, shrink, climb into dock.

[s16 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=17 engine=16 accuracy=100.0

[p52 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Phase 1 confirmed: 2x2 handle at SYS_C cols13-14 rows41-42 facing UP. Phase 2: drive RIGHT,RIGHT (along rail cols15-18 rows41-42) to cols17-18, then UP to cols17-18 rows39-40 (facing UP, directly below the red box). Then fire the 6-PROJECTILE legend (30,50)(30,55)(30,60): projectile travels UP cols17-18 and destroys the RED {6,D} box (cols17-20 rows33-36), clearing the linked RED gate and spawning a grow-marker at the box top-left (cols17-18 rows33-34). Next: drive up onto the grow-marker and GROW to 4x4.

[p53 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Phase 2 done (red box destroyed, red gate->rail, grow-marker at cols17-18 rows33-34). Handle 2x2 at cols17-18 rows39-40. Phase 3 (corrected): drive UP,UP to cols17-18 rows35-36, then RIGHT to topleft (19,35)=cols19-20 rows35-36 (all rail). Then fire DIAMOND GROW (30,50)(25,55)(35,55)(30,60): 4x4 footprint cols17-20 rows33-36 covers the marker+rail (verified passable) -> handle grows to 4x4, +8 budget. Next: teleport to SYS_A and fire at the orange box.

[p54 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Phase 3 done: handle 4x4 at cols17-20 rows33-36, budget 50. Phase 4: fire TELEPORT (25,50)(30,50)(30,55) -> 4x4 jumps to SYS_A cols53-56 rows37-40 (the 4x4 slot row-aligned with the orange box = firing-line tiebreak). Press LEFT(3) to face/slide the handle left to cols49-52 rows37-40 aimed at the orange box; the firing line cols41-52 is now clear rail (red gate cleared in Phase 2). Then fire 6-PROJECTILE (30,50)(30,55)(30,60) LEFT -> destroys orange {6,C} box, clears orange gate (cols33-36 rows14-16), opening the dock. Next: teleport to SYS_B, shrink, climb into dock.

[p55 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Phase 4 done: orange box destroyed, orange gate->rail, dock OPEN. Handle 4x4 at cols49-52 rows37-40, budget 40. Phase 5: fire TELEPORT (25,50)(30,50)(30,55) -> 4x4 jumps to the other 4x4 slot SYS_B (cols29-32 rows33-36, on the dock rail system; no boxes remain so it is the only other 4x4 slot). Then fire DIAMOND SHRINK (30,50)(25,55)(35,55)(30,60) -> 2x2 keeping top-left = cols29-30 rows33-34. Final phase next: climb the central column 13 moves into the dock (cols32-37 rows8-12) to WIN.
